messages:
Elena: Heads up — procurement asked for a clearer pricing waterfall for private offers tied to committed spend + renewal triggers. Can we align on a playbook before next Tues?
Mike: Yes. We need to map tiered discounts to procurement timelines. Fixed % off feels too blunt for big HW partners.
Ravi: Agreed. Recommend blended credits + step-down discounts by consumption bucket. Keeps ARR commitments intact and gives procurement visibility. Also need SKU mapping for SI co-sell bundles.
Sarah: Also flag renewal remediation — procurement hates surprise true-ups. Propose a renewal trigger: if avg utilization across last 3 months < 70% -> offer one-time ramp credit or 3mo extension (subject to SI delivery plan).
Elena: Draft matrix below (very rough):
```
Tier A: Commit >= $500k/yr -> 20% list discount + $50k onboarding credit (banked over 6mo)
Tier B: Commit >= $250k/yr -> 12% list discount + $25k onboarding credit
Tier C: Commit >= $100k/yr -> 6% list discount + $10k onboarding credit
Renewal trigger: If usage < 70% -> up to 25% of onboarding credit refundable as uplift credit OR 3mo extension (customer choice).
SI kicker: If partner delivers certified implementation within 90 days -> additional 5% on next renewal or one-time $10k SI success credit.
```
Mike: Legal will push on "refundable" credits. We should phrase as "remediation/uplift credit contingent on documented plan" and require customer opt-in to remediation.
Ravi: Fine. Add an SI milestone requirement to get the SI kicker. Also include a procurement-facing reconciliation cadence: monthly usage reports + quarterly reconciliation.
Elena: Good. Also need messaging for marketplace/private-offer SKU names so customers don't confuse with metered listings. Proposed: `Redwood Reserved - Commit X (Private Offer)` and separate line item for "SI Services".
Sarah: Ops ask: ensure marketplace meter maps to our internal consumption meter. If they diverge, procurement will escalate. Add a reconciliation clause in private offer T&C: disputes submitted within 45 days.
Mike: For announcements: don't publish pricing until SI certification and partner marketing have aligned. We should do a coordinated partner announcement 2 weeks after KA customer closes.
Elena: @partner-bot please create a task to capture action items and owners.
partner-bot: Task created: pricing-playbook-draft -> owner: Elena, due_in: 3 business days. (task id: pb-2026-05)
Ravi: I'll add sample contract language for the remediation clause and SI milestone.
Mike: I'll loop in Legal + RevOps. Quick Q: do we want a hard floor for discounts (e.g., no < 6%)?
Elena: Yes, floor = 5% after approvals. Anything below needs CRO approval.
Sarah: 👍 Also recommend a short FAQ for procurement teams explaining credits flow and example scenarios (e.g., 60% utilization -> how credit applied).
Elena: I'll draft the FAQ + spreadsheet with sample math. Sharing by EOD Friday.
Mike: :thumbsup:
Ravi: :thumbsup:
Sarah: :thumbsup:
Elena: Thanks all — we'll reconvene once draft is up.
